annotation.title_clean: GobTechLab (Laboratorio ciudadano de innovación tecnológica en la Administración)
annotation.title_en: GobTechLab (Citizen laboratory for technological innovation in the Administration)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio para la Transformación Digital y de la Función Pública (España Digital 2026)
named_instruments_referenced: Plan de Digitalización de las Administraciones Públicas 2021-2025
annotation.summary_en: Spanish government web page describing GobTechLab, an innovation lab of the central administration for co-creating digital public services with citizens and firms using AI, data analytics and blockchain. It is part of Spain's National AI Strategy and the 2021-2025 Public Administration Digitalisation Plan. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates an experimentation lab for personalised, innovative public services with citizen co-creation
Focuses on AI, data analytics and blockchain, including EU projects such as EBSI
Includes a startup launchpad to address administration modernisation challenges
Measure under the National AI Strategy and Digitalisation Plan 2021-2025
Responsible entity: Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service
